audience.text: Python developers who need to programmatically create, read, and modify Excel .xlsx workbooks in applications running on Python 3.7 or later.

capabilities.text: Create new workbooks or load existing .xlsx files and modify worksheets, cells, and content.
capabilities.title: Create and edit Excel workbooks

capabilities.text: Modify fonts, colors, sizes, alignment, and number formats via Style objects applied to cells.
capabilities.title: Apply cell styling and formatting

capabilities.text: Define dropdown lists, number ranges, and custom formulas using DataValidation, and apply rule-based formatting.
capabilities.title: Add data validation and conditional formatting

capabilities.text: Export workbook data to CSV, JSON, and Markdown using dedicated save methods.
capabilities.title: Export to text formats

capabilities.text: Create and modify charts, shapes, sparklines, and structured Excel tables with auto-filters.
capabilities.title: Support charts, shapes, and tables

capabilities.text: Apply and remove password protection using Agile encryption per ECMA-376 Part 2 §4.
capabilities.title: Encrypt and decrypt workbooks

limitations.text: Only .xlsx is supported for native load/save; CSV, JSON, and Markdown are additional text-format export targets, not general spreadsheet formats.
Only Agile encryption (ECMA-376 Part 2, Section 4) is supported for reading and writing password-protected workbooks; Standard encryption is not yet supported for reading.
FormulaEvaluator is a basic evaluator for cells without cached values and is not a full spreadsheet calculation engine.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook manipulation without Microsoft Excel installed, using pure Python.
Supports password protection for workbooks using Agile encryption per ECMA-376 Part 2 §4.
Provides export to common text formats including CSV, JSON, and Markdown.
Supports data validation, conditional formatting, auto filters, charts, shapes, tables, sparklines, and cell styling.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Python is a free, open-source, pure-Python library for creating, reading, and modifying Excel .xlsx workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel.

uncertainties: Whether Standard encryption (ECMA-376 Part 2, Section 3) is supported for writing workbooks is not stated.
The exact set of supported chart types beyond the 16 named in the inherited README is not confirmed by facts.
Whether embedded OLE objects beyond pictures are supported is not confirmed by facts.
Whether pivot tables are supported is not confirmed by facts.

workflows.name: Create and save a new workbook
workflows.text: Create a new Workbook instance, populate cells, and save as .xlsx using Workbook.save().

workflows.name: Read an existing workbook
workflows.text: Load an existing .xlsx file using Workbook(path), access cells, and read values.

workflows.name: Apply cell styling
workflows.text: Get a cell's Style, modify font properties, and apply it back using Cell.apply_style().

workflows.name: Add data validation
workflows.text: Add a DataValidation to a worksheet range using DataValidationCollection.add() and set its type and formula.

workflows.name: Export to CSV
workflows.text: Load an .xlsx workbook and save it as CSV using Workbook.save_as_csv().

workflows.name: Password-protect a workbook
workflows.text: Save a workbook with a password using Workbook.save(path, password=...) and load encrypted workbooks with Workbook(path, password=...).
